title: Your own capstone
description:
Plan and build a project of your own that uses at least three milestones of this course.

```
plan: a level editor for my game, with a memory-safe file format, an ImGui interface and mod support
milestones used: 2 (memory), 13 (mods), 14 (UI), 17 (testing)
week 1: file format + tests; week 2: editor core; week 3: UI; week 4: mods and polish
```
hints: Choose something you would use yourself; that is the best way to keep going (lesson 18.01).
Finish a small version first, then add to it: a working small project beats a large unfinished one.
requirements: Write a one-page plan: what it does, which milestones it uses, and what "done" means.
Split it into steps you can finish in one sitting each, with tests where you can.
Keep a short log of what you built, what broke and how you fixed it.
stretch: Share it with a friend and fix the first three things they find confusing.
